steps.title: The question
steps.say: Let's ask: what if you'd put 1,000 dollars into VOO a year ago?

steps.title: The result
steps.say: It would be worth {end_value} today, a change of {return_pct} percent.
steps.alt: The year's line with a tap at the end.

steps.title: The worst drop
steps.say: The biggest fall along the way was {max_dd} percent, around {dd_date}. Feel the dip. Holding through drops like this is the hard part.
steps.alt: The line with a tap at its lowest point.

steps.title: Past is not a promise
steps.say: This tells you what happened, not what will happen. Prices can fall as well as rise.

quiz.q: What does a backtest tell you?
quiz.why: A backtest replays history. It cannot predict the future.
